notes.title: The game is now 65% complete
notes.notes: Released a new trailer showing some of the new environment and bosses. You can watch it on the store page or on [url=https://youtu.be/3-pk2Atq0DY]Youtube[/url]. The trailer doesn't include everything that is complete, I want to save the rest for the game itself. I hope you like the trailer and the progress so far.
